body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary hostile mental Condition until the start of your next turn; reduce its next incoming Psychic or Arcane Damage by 1 during that time.

surges.html: Gain +1 Composure on the target until the start of your next turn.
Suppress one non-Critical mental Wound Condition's numerical penalties for the same duration.

rider.title: Strain - Barrier
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, the target cannot receive a second copy of the suppressed ordinary Condition from the same source before your next turn; different effects still apply.
